deaths.label: Reported deaths / remains
deaths.summary: Recovery tally includes unidentified and partial remains.
deaths.note: Official recovery tally includes 526 entries for human remains; it is not a count of individually identified victims.

missing.label: People reported missing
missing.note: May overlap with unidentified remains, rescued people or duplicate entries. Do not add this figure to the death tally.

injured.label: Injured treated by security teams
injured.summary: Reported treatment count, not a complete injury toll.
injured.note: Security-agency treatment figure. Separately, 18 people were in hospital. The latest report does not provide a complete cumulative injury total; these categories are not added together.

rescued.label: People rescued
rescued.summary: Cumulative rescue count reported by NDRRMA.
rescued.note: Reported rescues; this is not a count of people currently displaced.

homes.label: Private buildings damaged
homes.note: Government RDNA, summarized by Nepal Red Cross on 13 September. Counts damaged private buildings, not only destroyed homes. Replaces the earlier approximate housing figure; definitions differ.

damage.label: Estimated physical damage
damage.summary: Buildings and infrastructure; initial RDNA estimate.
damage.note: Rounded government estimate of physical damage, separate from economic losses and reconstruction needs. A fuller post-disaster assessment is still pending.

losses.label: Estimated economic losses
losses.summary: Disrupted income and economic activity, in USD.
losses.note: Rounded RDNA loss estimate. This is separate from damage to physical assets.

recovery.label: Recovery & reconstruction
recovery.summary: Estimated funding needed to rebuild and recover.
recovery.note: Rounded government estimate of reconstruction requirements. It is not an additional damage amount and must not be added to damage and losses.
